task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Use pytket to build a 4-qubit circuit of 3 layers (H + CX ladder + RZ), then optimize it with FullPeepholeOptimise and rebase to {CX, Rz, H}. Print gate counts before and after. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
